high_level_description: The image shows an old, worn-out "Forget-Me-Not" Indicator Appointment Book being held open by a person's hand. The book appears to be quite aged, with yellowed pages and some creases, indicating it has been used extensively over time. The cover of the book is partially visible on the right side, showing the title "Forget-Me-Not Indicator Appointment Book" along with the name "GEO. H. MILNER." Below the title, there is a note that mentions the book was printed and published by "Thomas De La Rue & Co., Ltd., Bunhill Row, London, E.C."
